question: Open the release-acceptance task (issue #571) and start ideation?

artifacts.summary: Release-scale acceptance as a standard mechanism: kc-dev-flow-2 owns when the acceptance task opens, who walks, what the report carries and how failures route back to release review; kc-journey-map gets a mode that produces the walk list and takes the result back; joined by a declared contract. Also enforce the pre-implementation release review at dispatch. Evidence: the R3 and R4 hand-run walks.
